simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מַזְלֵג (H4207) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 7 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: מַזְלֵג (mazlêg) means a fork First listed occurrence: 1Chr 28 17.

definitions.full: H4207. mazleg מַזְלֵג noun masculine apparently a sacrificial implement, three-pronged fork ׳הַמּ הַשִּׁנַּיִם שְׁלשׁ 1Sam 2:13 , compare 2:14 (see Dr Sm. pp. 23, 291 ). [ מִזְלָגָה ] noun [feminine] id., only plural הַמִּזְלָֹגת Exod 38:3 ; Num 4:14 ; הַמִּזְלָגוֺת 1Chr 28:17 ; 2Chr 4:16 ; suffix מִזְלְֹגתָיו Exod 27:3 ; — a sacrificial implement, belonging to altar in tabernacle, 27:3 ; 38:3 ; Num 4:14 (all P); belonging to temple 1Chr 28:17 ; 2Chr 4:16 .
definitions.rootNote: or (feminine) מִזְלָגָה ; from an unused root meaning to draw up;
